description: Today's departures on record from an airport (airport-local day; date picks another local day), optionally only those to one destination (an airport code, or a city matched as whole words) or flown by one airline: finds flights without knowing their number. coverage is on_record: the counts cover the flights on record for this airport today, not its full schedule. Counts over the matching flights: departed_today (a departure is recorded and the flight is not cancelled), past_due_not_reported (not cancelled, no recorded departure, scheduled at or before now_utc), still_to_depart (not cancelled, no recorded departure, scheduled after now_utc) and cancelled_today. flights lists the still-to-depart ones, never a cancelled one (scope day lists every matching flight of the day instead, departed and cancelled ones included; total counts the flights the scope lists, returned how many this answer holds): number, operating flight for codeshares, destination, scheduled, estimated and actual departure in UTC, status, delay in minutes from the scheduled time, verdict (delayed means more than late_threshold_minutes plus the airport's taxi_allowance_minutes; a recorded departure is not_graded with a null allowance or more than 60 minutes before its schedule), a link to its flight page and, when one is open, to its market. Without an airline filter, codeshare listings of one flight count once. The result links the gaduin.com page of the route when the destination is one airport with flights on record today, else the departure airport's page.

airline.description: Airline IATA or ICAO code (e.g. BA or BAW).

date.description: Departure airport-local date YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 400 days or ahead. Defaults to the airport's today.

from.description: Departure airport. Airport IATA code (e.g. LHR) or ICAO code (e.g. EGLL).

limit.description: Max flights to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

scope.description: upcoming (default) lists the still-to-depart flights; day lists every matching flight scheduled to depart that local day (with no schedule, departed on it), departed and cancelled ones included.

to.description: Destination airport IATA or ICAO code, or city name (e.g. JFK, KJFK or New York).

name: search_flights
title: Search flights by route
